title: The Little Guardians
subtitle: A small hand clutches a treasure tightly, so much that none may steal it.

trails.title: The sun rises and the moon veils its face. Life's gentle fingers guide each tender seedling, a hint of a different path free of monotony.
Venus shines. Thoughts flow easily from your lips into your pen. The wellspring of Creation shall gush unabated.
Jupiter falls silent. Light a lamp in your attic and allow your boundless imagination to wander.
Mercury is in retrograde. A projector that plays on its own, the predictions that issue forth uninvited. Any desire for reticence must be stymied.
The Moon hangs high in the sky, the Sun in its thrall. Heaven and Earth have joined hands again, as they did when the world was born.
The Other Mountain Boulder
trails.description: They have pieced him together with fragments from many places. The forests and the mountains, with long practice, and the essence of yesterday.

items.text: They gather before the ceramic vat in the yard.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Are you sure? To use this?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: What's wrong with it? It has enough water to soak me in.
Shamane looks at the old vat and then checks the filthy water and rotten leaves inside. There is a silence between them.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Hmm, you are much more practical than I thought.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Oh, before I go ...
She hands the Vishnu idol to Matilda.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Hmm? Aren't you going to take it with you, Ms. Kaalaa Baunaa?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: No.
She slowly shakes her head.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Shamane has a point. This is our last chance to win this fight, and it should be kept away from Kumar as far as possible.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Emm.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Ms. Kaalaa Baunaa, take this with you then!
Matilda passes over a crystal. It is shining brightly, like a freshly picked star.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: This is your ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: My pendulum! It's one of my collections, one of the purest! Even I don't have a lot of them around.

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: I realized that the theory of meditation you've talked about is quite similar to some of the crystal divination theories. So, perhaps this will help you in the water, if the crystal can stabilize the magnetic field and guide you in there.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: You ...

items.speaker: Matilda
items.text: Humph, no need to be surprised. This is how quickly a genius can think!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Thank you.

items.speaker: Shamane
items.text: Ah, great. So, it's only me who can't understand this "meditation in water" thing. Well, it takes all sorts of rocks to form a mountain.
Before he finishes his sentence, Kaalaa Baunaa has quickly submerged her legs in the water, as if the cold didn't bother her at all.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Okay, the pendulum and enough liquid.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: And all I have to do now is ...

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Think of Kumar.
She bends her knees and lets herself slide into the water.
Her world is immediately free of sounds.
As soon as her head is completely submerged in water, the cold attacks from all directions.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: *inhales*
Be it real or false, delusional or real, a world reappears before her.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Where else could it be more suitable ...

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: ... than the place we first met?
The familiar stone stairs extend much longer than she remembers. The rough red bricks, the well-calculated and carefully designed arc ... Everything in Jantar Mantar has a unique kind of beauty.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Hah. How thoughtful you were, Kumar ...

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: ... to recreate the observatory in the Realm.
The figure standing still on its top looks like a black singularity.
She knows who it is.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Just an illusion in my mind.
Now, her left foot is on the first step.
Resistance is expected.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: She remembered almost every detail of me as a child.
The figure standing in front of her greatly resembles her younger self—always fist-clenching, always ready for confrontation.
And now "the girl" is irritated by the intrusion.
"She" rushes toward Kaalaa Baunaa and throws quick punches.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Oh, it hurts!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Did it hurt this much when I hit someone as a child?

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: Get out! You should not be here!
"She" tries to drive Kaalaa Baunaa away, fighting her like a trained warrior.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Ah, yes. Mom had taught me a few moves to deal with those brats at that age.

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: Leave!

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Hmm. This feels weird.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Did Kumar put you here? To guard this fragment of memory?

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: This shall be the obstacle in my way to where I want to be.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: It's time to face the illusion from the past.

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: Ah!
The illusion is dispersed and then gathers again in the distance, but this time, "she" is no longer irritated.

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: Heh heh.
"She" gradually fades away in the light and shadow of the observatory, and her voice goes further and further.

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: From the past, to the present, and the future.

items.speaker: Illusion
items.text: The thing you are clinging on to, facing, and chasing ... Think what it is.
Kaalaa Baunaa lowers her head to look at her palm.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: You are still asking questions that cannot be answered, just as you always did.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: What do you think I "should" chase after?
Her fingers clench gently.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I won't be misled this time, Kumar.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: I have never given up studying astronomy since that day.
There is only an echo in the empty space. The illusion has gone.
She looks up at the almost endless stairs.

items.speaker: Kaalaa Baunaa
items.text: Keep moving.
